zh.title: 國家航空完成波音777F自蘇格蘭飛往澳洲長途航班
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，國家航空近期使用波音777F貨機完成了一趟自蘇格蘭前往澳洲的長途飛行航程。該架777F貨機從蘇格蘭起飛，歷經19小時24分鐘後順利抵達澳洲，總飛行距離達到11315英里。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，國家航空（National Airlines）近期完成了一趟創紀錄的波音777F長途飛行任務。該架波音777F貨機自蘇格蘭起飛出發，最終順利跨越長途航程飛抵澳洲。
這趟由國家航空執飛的波音777F航班，總飛行距離長達11315英里。該架貨機自蘇格蘭離場起飛之後，持續飛行並於19小時又24分鐘後順利抵達目的地澳洲。
根據 Simple Flying 報導的相關訊息，這趟連接蘇格蘭與澳洲的直飛航程耗時約20小時，飛行總里程達到11315英里，成功完成了波音777F貨機的長途飛行紀錄。

en.title: National Airlines Completes 11,315-Mile Boeing 777F Flight To Australia
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying, National Airlines has completed a record-breaking Boeing 777F flight. The freighter aircraft departed from Scotland and arrived in Australia 19 hours and 24 minutes later. Simple Flying reported that the flight covered a total distance of 11,315 miles and lasted approximately 20 hours. The direct operation connects Scotland and Australia following the successful long-haul completion by National Airlines using its Boeing 777F cargo aircraft.
body: National Airlines has completed a record-breaking flight operating a Boeing 777F freighter aircraft, according to a report by Simple Flying. The aircraft departed from Scotland and safely reached its destination in Australia.

The flight covered a total distance of 11,315 miles and spanned approximately 20 hours. Simple Flying reported that the Boeing 777F spent 19 hours and 24 minutes in the air between its departure in Scotland and arrival in Australia.
The completed journey marks a long-distance flight achievement for National Airlines as it operated the Boeing 777F cargo aircraft on the long-haul route from Scotland to Australia.
